originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Separate developmental ancestry, broad cell identity and reversible activity state from genetic tumor-clone relationships.
originalFrozenTask.gap: The three-question Mermaid and caption name the axes, but its sequential boxes do not show one cell family/clone containing cycling and noncycling states or why an RNA cluster cannot reconstruct ancestry.
accuracyGuardrails: Use explicitly fictional cells with independently labeled lineage, clone and state; avoid a developmental trajectory inferred from markers or a claim of permanent commitment.

generatorCustody: Original generator privately retained, not publicly delivered; editable SVG without an executable reproduction-package promise.
sourceDepth: Actual primary abstracts and selected primary/official passages; exact per-owner private lookup/depth/failure/custody receipts. No whole-paper/clinical/scientific approval implied.
themeMethod: Exact shared geometry and wording, palette substitutions only
